description: Revert to the proven aggressive Matrix LR (0.11) and Embedding LR (1.4) configuration with Depth 10 and Batch 128, as historical data confirms this setup achieves the best convergence speed (~0.983 bpb) within the 5-minute budget, whereas the lower LR (0.08) under-utilizes the time and the higher depth (12) causes instability or slower convergence in this short timeframe.
